title: Area and Security Lighting Rental Agreement Terms: Removal, Minimum Term and Early Removal
content:
Removing an **Area and Security Lighting Rental** light is the member's own decision and is made only on the member's confirmed request; the light is removed within 10 business days of that confirmed request. A light removed before the fixture's minimum rental term has passed since installation is charged the remaining whole months of the term multiplied by the fixture's monthly rental, but never more than the fixture's early removal cap. A light removed at the cooperative's initiative, or after the term, carries no removal charge.

## Minimum term and early removal cap by fixture

| Fixture | Minimum rental term from installation (months) | Monthly rental (USD) | Most charged for removal before the term ends (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| LED 40W Security Light | 36 | 9.85 | 250.00 |
| LED 70W Area Light | 36 | 12.40 | 300.00 |
| LED 110W Flood Light | 60 | 17.95 | 450.00 |
| LED 150W Flood Light | 60 | 22.60 | 550.00 |
| HPS 100W Security Light | 0 (no minimum term) | 11.25 | 0.00 |
| HPS 250W Flood Light | 0 (no minimum term) | 19.80 | 0.00 |
| Mercury Vapor 175W Security Light | 0 (no minimum term) | 13.10 | 0.00 |

## Terms read closely

- **Whose decision.** Only the member decides to remove a light, and only a request the member has confirmed puts the light into removal pending. The removal clock of 10 business days runs from that confirmed request.
- **Months installed.** The months that have passed are the whole calendar months elapsed from the installation date to the removal date, each month counted to the same day number of the later month.
- **Remaining months.** The remaining whole months of the term are the minimum term less the whole months installed.
- **The charge.** The early removal charge is the remaining whole months multiplied by the fixture's monthly rental, or the early removal cap if that is lower.
- **No charge.** A light removed once its minimum term has passed, or removed at the cooperative's initiative, carries no removal charge. A fixture with no minimum term is never removed before its term.

## Worked figures (hypothetical lights)

| Light | Installed | Removed | Whole months installed | Remaining months | Remaining months multiplied by monthly rental | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| LED 40W Security Light | March 15, Year 1 | September 14, Year 3 | 29 | 7 | 68.95 | 68.95 |
| LED 40W Security Light | March 15, Year 1 | March 15, Year 4 | 36 | 0 | — | None, the term has passed |
| LED 70W Area Light | June 1, Year 1 | February 1, Year 2 | 8 | 28 | 347.20 | 300.00 (the cap) |
| LED 150W Flood Light | May 10, Year 1 | May 10, Year 4 | 36 | 24 | 542.40 | 542.40 |
| Mercury Vapor 175W Security Light | any date | any date | any | none | — | None, no minimum term |

In the first row, September 14 is one day short of the 15th, so the 30th month is not yet complete: 29 whole months. A light the cooperative removes on its own initiative carries no removal charge at any point in its term.
